title: Concept: pnpm applies a local patch to a published dependency
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm patch entry that rewrites a published package before install, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installed code differs from the package the registry published and from the code an advisory range describes, so review and matching both drift.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: The installed code differs from the package the registry published and from the code an advisory range describes, so review and matching both drift.
